definitions.explanation: Having an even surface without roughness or bumps. Often describes texture.
Moving or proceeding without difficulties or interruptions. Used for speech, movements, or processes.

notes:
FORMS:
- Adverb: {滑|なめ}らかに (smoothly)
- Noun: {滑|なめ}らかさ (smoothness)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {滑|なめ}らかな⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (smooth skin)
- {滑|なめ}らかな⟦{口調|くちょう}→口調：11803_kuchou⟧ (smooth tone of voice)
- {滑|なめ}らかに⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (proceed smoothly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すべすべ→すべすべ：05163_subesube⟧ - smooth to the touch (often for skin)
- ⟦つるつる→つるつる：05175_tsurutsuru⟧ - slippery smooth (can imply too slippery)
- {滑|なめ}らか is more literary and can describe both texture and abstract smoothness.
